[glod].description.t: Your stomach ties itself in a knot, and your legs go soft.

[glod_konanie].description.t: Your feet stumble on their own, and flies that aren't there swim before your eyes.

[glod_lekki].description.t: Your stomach reminds you it's still there.

[krwawienie].description.t: The wound won't close. A bandage will help.

[mocny_napar].description.t: A bitter root brew warms the muscles. Endurance rises while it lasts.

[najedzony].description.t: A warm meal in your belly. A surer hand, a stronger stride.

[natluszczone_ostrze].description.t: The blade slides over skin more smoothly. Every blow bites deeper.

[ogluszenie].description.t: Your head's ringing. For a moment you can't move hand or foot.

[oslepienie].description.t: Can't see a thing: hard to land a blow or dodge one.

[ostrze_ognia].description.t: The blade glows with violet fire and burns with every blow.

[podchmielenie].description.t: The tongue's loosened, the hand's less sure.

[podpalenie].description.t: Fire licks at clothes and skin.

[rozkojarzenie].description.t: Thoughts wander off, the hand loses its rhythm.

[spowolnienie].description.t: The legs won't obey: every move is slow and heavy.

[strach].description.t: The knees go weak, the hands shake.

[trucizna].description.t: Venom in the veins burns from the inside.

[wracajacy_grot].description.t: The spearhead turns back in flight and shields you from a blow. You're harder to hit.

[zadymienie].description.t: Acrid smoke hides the field. Shots vanish into the murk, and it's easier to slip away.

[zamroczenie].description.t: Everything swims, and the hands won't obey. Hard to land a blow or dodge one.

[zaslona].description.t: A dark veil deadens every blow.

[zmeczenie].description.t: The body begs for sleep. Movements are slower, the eyes dull.
